678-4939-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
678-4939-7272.description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying its mana cost.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary.
When Burning-Tree Emissary dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

883-4279-6026--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
883-4279-6026--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4279-6255-6559--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6255-6559--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1456-5078-5223-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7742-7913.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7742-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

5660-6441-6462-6753-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

2034-3490-6752-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-6752-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2034-3490-4476-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-4476-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

891-2730-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-1879-2557-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

57-3480-4846-6657.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-3480-4846-6657.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2466-5051-5078-5741.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Traxos, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

339-677-4927-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

645-2060-3750-5231-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2060-3750-5231-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer, adding {R}.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

1323-3151-4687.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Elves.
1323-3151-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Elvish Archdruid's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

3765-5049-6102.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
3765-5049-6102.notablePrerequisites:
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
3765-5049-6102.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 1, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

428-1694-2770-5362.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
You have enough mana to cast Donate and Quantum Misalignment.
428-1694-2770-5362.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

1308-1651-2561-4559.description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Metalwork Colossus, creating two Food tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Foods, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

527-1268.notablePrerequisites:
Crab Umbra attached to Selvala.
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
527-1268.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat.
If you control a creature with power 5 or greater, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

2359-4167-4186.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2359-4167-4186.description:

Elrond's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.

225-1021-1315-2605.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.

Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

528-877-1374-1813-3211.description:
Cast Buried Alive to put Corpse Knight, Dauntless Bodyguard, and Haakon from your library into your graveyard.
Cast Haakon from your graveyard.
Cast Dauntless Bodyguard and Corpse Knight from your graveyard each for {0}.
Sacrifice Dauntless Bodyguard.
Cast Dauntless Bodyguard from your graveyard.
It enters, triggering Corpse Knight.
Repeat steps 4-6.

1958-2275-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Prophetic Ravings attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
At least one card in hand.
1958-2275-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to discard a card and draw a card.
When you draw a card, Shabraz will trigger, gaining you 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Gaining the life untaps Famished Paladin.
Repeat.
